svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.aria-label: A floating waybar of frosted pills: workspaces with a glyph per open window, the window title, Tannoy's media pill with a small podcast cover and Slow Signals · Where the Night Trains…, cut at a word with a real ellipsis, then the lamps, audio, the desk pill with Logbook's mic and a drawer handle, the clock and the tray. A click on the cover opens the Tannoy drawer out of it: the podcast playing in Chrome with its scrub bar moving, previous and next, play and pause, and 15 second skips. A click on the forward skip jumps ahead and a click on pause stops it, dimming the bar pill. A click on the Spotify chip picks Spotify: the cover, the title and the bar pill swap to a song, the skips give way to shuffle and repeat toggles, an Auto chip appears, and play starts it. Do not disturb turns on: the bell turns amber, the bar keeps only a dim music glyph, and the drawer shrinks to say the title is hidden while its controls stay. Do not disturb turns off again, and a click outside closes the drawer.
